messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | **l'ora** | “the hour” (temporal noun) | **గంట** | “hour” | OK | | **del** | genitive “of” linking *ora* to *tempo* | **సమయపు** | “of time” | OK | | **tempo** | “time” (noun) | **సమయపు** | “time’s” (genitive) | OK | | **e** | coordinating “and” | **మరియు** | “and” | OK | | **la** (before *dolce*) | definite article, fem. sing. | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **dolce** | “sweet” (adjective) | **మధురమైన** | “sweet” | OK | | **stagione;** | “season” (noun) + end‑punctuation | **ఋతువు;** | “season;” | OK | | **ma** | contrastive “but” | **కాని** | “but” | OK | | **non** (1st) | first part of double negative “not so” | **అంతగా** | “so” (as part of “not so”) | **WRONG** | | **sì** | intensifier “so” | **అంతగా** | “so” | **WRONG** | | **che** (subordinator) | “that” introducing clause | **అది** | “that” | OK | | **paura** | “fear” (noun, object of “give”) | **భయాన్ని** | “fear” (accusative) | OK | | **non** (2nd) | negation of the verb “give” | **ఇవ్వకపోవడానికి** | “to not give” | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person indirect object “to me” | **నాకు** | “to me” | OK | | **desse** | subjunctive “give” (potential causation) | **ఇవ్వకపోవడానికి** | “to give” (negated) | OK | | **la** (before *vista*) | definite article, fem. sing. | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **vista** | “sight” (head noun) | **దర్శనం** | “sight” | OK | | **che** (relative) | relative pronoun “which/that” | **యొక్క** | “of/that” | OK | | **m'apparve** | “appeared” (verb, subjunctive) | **కనిపించింది** | “appeared” | OK | | **d'un** | preposition + indefinite article “of a” | **యొక్క** | “of” (genitive) | OK | | **leone.** | “lion” (noun) + end‑punctuation | **లయన్‌.** | “lion.” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
| Issue Type | Source Word(s) | Reason | |------------|----------------|--------| | **WRONG** | **non** (1st) & **sì** | Both were collapsed into a single Telugu word **అంతగా**; the source distinguishes a negation and an intensifier, which the translation does not reflect separately. | | **UNNECESSARY** | **la** (twice) | Italian definite articles have no direct counterpart in Telugu and were omitted, which is appropriate but flagged as unnecessary. |
All other mappings are **OK**.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 43: - Original: సమయపు గంట మరియు మధురమైన ఋతువు; - Issue: none - Corrected: సమయపు గంట మరియు మధురమైన ఋతువు;
- Line 44: - Original: కాని అది లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు భయాన్ని ఇవ్వకపోవడానికి అంతగా కాదు - Issue: WRONG – the double‑negative “non … non” and the intensifier “sì” were collapsed incorrectly; the clause order was reversed. - Corrected: కాని అంతగా కాదు లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు భయాన్ని ఇవ్వలేదు
- Line 45: - Original: లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు కనిపించింది. - Issue: none - Corrected: లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు కనిపించింది.
``` సమయపు గంట మరియు మధురమైన ఋతువు; కాని అంతగా కాదు లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు భయాన్ని ఇవ్వలేదు లయన్‌ యొక్క దర్శనం నాకు కనిపించింది. ```
